title: Exist Here
survival_class: Class Pending (Habitable, Undeveloped, Devoid of Entities); final panel: Class Pending - Non-existent
physical_identity: A clean empty beach facing a sea to the east, surrounded by mountains; no plants, animals or structures; irregular tides; the sea sounds wrong and shows drowned faces.
scale_topology: Finite; ebb exposes at most about 20 km2 of beach; entrance in the western mountain.
anomalies: sea sounds of machines, voices and prayers (testimony)
level appears to resist base construction
lighting_sound: Quiet beach with waves; near the sea the waves become layered noise (testimony).
